{"PROG_ID": "get_instance_id_except_post", "QUERY_ID": "FP\Common\BigFilter_FP", "QUERY_SEQ": "0", "INST_SEQ": "0", "QUERY_VALUE": "---Service Parameter : 0USER_ID
